verdict.rationale: FireHydrant runs incidents from Slack. Runbooks fire on declaration (docs-60) and automate creating the incident Slack channel (docs-2). The default runbook assigns the opener as Commander (docs-7, docs-41). Responders use `/fh` inside the incident channel (docs-8) and post updates with `/fh update` (docs-65). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of declaring an incident from a Slack command, any Microsoft Teams support evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Slack workflow.
